newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products weak, gas oil falls nearly $4.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products weak, gas oil falls nearly $4.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Monday, traders said.
Gasoline barges fell $1 to $200/$201 fob for Eurograde, hurt by a shut arbitrage and weaker crude. A 60,000 tonne cargo of blending stock was still on offer for the States, traders said.
Naphtha fell $2.50 for March swaps, hurt by crude and sluggish end-user demand. Far East swaps buying was still seen.
Gas oil fell almost $4 reflecting sharply lower futures. Premiums held despite only limited interest.
High and low sulphur fuel oil fell by $2-$3. High sulphur barges traded at $85-$88 fob ARA.
